examples.en: The patient went into the operating room.
The family waited in front of the operating room.
An operating room must always be very clean.
The doctors move busily in the operating room.

examples.ko: 수술실에 들어가기 전에 아빠가 제 손을 잡았어요.
examples.en: Before I went into the operating room, my dad held my hand.

examples.ko: 이 병원에는 수술실이 열 개 넘게 있어요.
examples.en: This hospital has more than ten operating rooms.

explain: 병원의 방 이름은 '-실'로 끝나는 말이 많아요. 수술실, 진료실, 응급실이 그래요. 수술하는 방은 '수술실', 입원한 사람이 지내는 방은 '병실'이라서 구별해서 써요.

phrases.en: The doctor came out of the operating room.
phrases.nuance_ko: 수술이 끝나고 나올 때 써요. '들어가다'와 반대예요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use this when someone comes out after surgery; it is the opposite of '들어가다'.
phrases.en_equiv: to come out of the operating room

phrases.en: It was very quiet inside the operating room.
phrases.nuance_ko: 수술실 안쪽의 모습을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use this to describe the inside of the operating room.

phrases.en: The operating room light is still on.
phrases.nuance_ko: 수술이 아직 끝나지 않았다는 뜻으로 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used to show that the surgery isn't over yet.

explain_en: Many hospital room names end in '-실', such as '수술실', '진료실' and '응급실'. A room for surgery is a '수술실', while a room where an inpatient stays is a '병실', so keep them apart.

examples.en: I dye my hair this weekend.
Yesterday I dyed my hair brown at the salon.
I have gray hair, so I plan to dye it.

examples.ko: 옷을 천연 재료로 염색하는 체험을 했어요.
examples.en: I did an activity of dyeing clothes with natural materials.
After dyeing, my look changed.
My dyed hair looks bright in the sunlight.

explain: '머리를 염색하다'처럼 머리색을 바꿀 때 많이 써요. 옷감에 물을 들일 때도 같은 말을 써요. 머리 모양을 바꾸는 '파마', '커트'와 구분해요.

phrases.en: Your dyed hair suits you well.
phrases.nuance_ko: 과거형 '염색한'이 명사 앞에서 '이미 물들인'이라는 뜻이 돼요.
phrases.nuance_en: The past modifier '염색한' before a noun means 'already dyed'.

phrases.en: Next time I want to dye it blue.
phrases.nuance_ko: 하고 싶은 일을 말할 때 쓰는 활용이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A form for saying what you want to do.

phrases.en: I spread the hair dye evenly on my hair.
phrases.nuance_ko: 염색하는 방법을 설명할 때 자주 나오는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A pair often used when explaining how to dye hair.

explain_en: It is often used for changing hair color, as in '머리를 염색하다'. The same word is used for dyeing fabric. Keep it separate from '파마' (perm) and '커트' (cut), which change hair shape.

examples.en: Please briefly tell me how to prevent the flu.

examples.ko: 가장 좋은 예방법은 손을 자주 씻는 거예요.
examples.en: The best way to prevent it is to wash your hands often.
There is no known way to prevent this disease yet.

examples.ko: 화재 예방법에 대해 선생님이 설명해 주셨어요.
examples.en: The teacher explained how to prevent fires.

examples.ko: 간단한 예방법만 지켜도 건강해질 수 있어요.
examples.en: Even following simple preventive tips can keep you healthy.
Also be sure to learn how to prevent food poisoning.

explain: 병이나 사고가 생기기 전에 막는 방법이에요. 이미 생긴 뒤에 하는 '치료법', '해결법'과 짝으로 기억하면 좋아요. 보통 '감기 예방법'처럼 앞에 무엇을 막는지 붙여요.

phrases.en: Do you know how to prevent colds?
phrases.nuance_ko: 앞에 막고 싶은 병이나 일을 붙여서 가장 흔하게 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common use, with the illness or problem to prevent in front.

phrases.en: The doctor told me how to prevent it.
phrases.nuance_ko: 방법을 가르쳐 줄 때 '알려 주다'와 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used with '알려 주다' when someone teaches the method.

phrases.example: 충분히 자는 것이 가장 좋은 예방법이에요.
phrases.en: Getting enough sleep is the best way to prevent it.
phrases.nuance_ko: 여러 방법 중에서 제일 좋은 것을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to name the best option among several methods.

explain_en: Everyday — practical how-to, such as health tips (감기 예방법) It means ways to stop illness or accidents before they happen. Remember it as a pair with '치료법' and '해결법', which come after the problem occurs. It usually follows the thing being prevented, as in '감기 예방법'.

t90.ax: The teacher explained how to prevent fires.

en: wool gloves; knit gloves; fur gloves

examples.en: My hands are warm because I put on woolen gloves.
I lost one of my woolen gloves.

examples.ko: 털장갑이 작아서 아이 손에 안 들어가요.
examples.en: The woolen gloves are small and don't fit on the child's hands.
I chose red for my new woolen gloves.

examples.ko: 털장갑 낀 채로 휴대폰을 하기 힘들어요.
examples.en: It's hard to use a phone with woolen gloves on.
Snow got on the woolen gloves and they got wet.

explain: 장갑은 손가락 부분에 '끼다'를 써서 '장갑을 끼다'라고 해요. 한 짝씩 '한 짝, 두 짝'으로 세고, 한 쌍은 '한 켤레'라고도 해요. 모자는 '쓰다', 목도리는 '하다/두르다'로 구분해요.

phrases.en: It was cold, so I went out wearing woolen gloves.
phrases.nuance_ko: 장갑은 '끼다'와 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Gloves go with the verb 'kkida'.

phrases.en: One pair of woolen gloves, please.
phrases.nuance_ko: 장갑 두 짝을 한 쌍으로 셀 때 '켤레'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: 'Kyeolle' counts a pair of gloves.

phrases.en: I gave woolen gloves to my mother as a gift.
phrases.nuance_ko: 겨울 선물로 자주 하는 물건이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common winter gift.
phrases.en_equiv: to give woolen gloves as a gift

explain_en: Gloves take the verb '끼다', as in '장갑을 끼다'. You count single gloves as '한 짝, 두 짝', and a pair can be '한 켤레'. Hats use '쓰다' and scarves use '하다' or '두르다'.

examples.en: After work I went to eat gamjatang with a friend.
The meat on the bones is delicious in gamjatang.
On cold days I think of hot gamjatang.

examples.ko: 감자탕 이 인분에 공기밥 하나 주세요.
examples.en: Please give us two servings of gamjatang and one bowl of rice.
I ate gamjatang and even fried rice, so I'm full.
This shop's gamjatang has a spicy, rich broth.

explain: 돼지 등뼈를 넣고 얼큰하게 끓인 탕이에요. 보통 큰 냄비에 여럿이 나눠 먹고, 다 먹은 뒤에 밥을 볶아 먹기도 해요. 식당에서는 '감자탕 중짜 하나 주세요'처럼 크기로 시켜요.

phrases.en: I had dinner at a gamjatang restaurant.
phrases.nuance_ko: 감자탕을 파는 식당을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to a restaurant that sells gamjatang.

phrases.en: We ordered gamjatang and ate it together.
phrases.nuance_ko: 식당에서 음식을 고를 때 '시키다'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: 시키다 is used when ordering food at a restaurant.

phrases.en: This place's gamjatang is a little spicy.
phrases.nuance_ko: 감자탕의 맛을 말할 때 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used to describe the taste of gamjatang.

explain_en: It is a spicy stew boiled with pork backbone. People usually share a big pot, and sometimes fry rice in the leftover broth. At restaurants you order by size, like '감자탕 중짜 하나 주세요'.

examples.ko: 감기 기운이 있어서 따뜻한 꿀물을 마셨어요.
examples.en: I felt a cold coming on, so I drank warm honey water.

examples.ko: 어머니가 꿀물 한 잔을 타 주셨어요.
examples.en: My mother made me a cup of honey water.

examples.ko: 꿀물에 레몬을 조금 넣으면 더 맛있어요.
examples.en: If you add a little lemon to honey water, it tastes better.

examples.ko: 꿀물이 너무 달아서 물을 더 탔어요.
examples.en: The honey water was too sweet, so I added more water.
People drink honey water both hot and cold.
I soothed my stomach with warm honey water in the morning.

explain: 꿀을 물에 탄 음료예요. 가루나 액체를 물에 섞을 때는 '타다'를 써서 '꿀물을 타다'라고 말해요. 따뜻하게도 차갑게도 마시는 집에서 만드는 음료예요.

phrases.en: I made honey water and drank it in the morning.
phrases.nuance_ko: 꿀을 물에 섞어 만든다고 할 때 '타다'와 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use 타다 with 꿀물 when you mix honey into water.

phrases.en: On cold days, warm honey water is nice.
phrases.nuance_ko: 온도를 말하는 '따뜻한'과 자주 같이 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often paired with 따뜻한 to talk about temperature.

phrases.example: 자기 전에 꿀물 한 잔을 마셔요.
phrases.en: I drink a glass of honey water before bed.
phrases.nuance_ko: 마시는 양을 '한 잔'으로 세어 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Counting the drink with 한 잔 (one cup).

explain_en: It is a drink of honey mixed into water. When mixing powder or liquid into water you use '타다', so you say '꿀물을 타다'. It is a simple homemade drink served warm or cold.

examples.en: This morning I boiled and ate some toasty nurungji.
Nurungji has stuck to the bottom of the rice cooker.
I eat nurungji snacks as a treat.
For the baby, I boiled the scorched rice until it was soft.

examples.ko: 식사 후에 누룽지를 한 그릇씩 줘요.
examples.en: They give each person a bowl of nurungji after the meal.

examples.ko: 누룽지 맛이 고소해서 자꾸 손이 가요.
examples.en: Nurungji tastes so nutty that I keep reaching for it.

explain: 밥솥 바닥에 눌어붙은 밥을 말해요. 거기에 물을 붓고 끓이면 '누룽지탕'이나 '숭늉'처럼 먹을 수 있고, 요즘은 과자나 차로도 팔아요. 맛은 '구수하다', '고소하다'라고 말해요.

phrases.en: I ate scorched rice soup this morning and my stomach felt good.
phrases.nuance_ko: 누룽지에 물을 붓고 끓인 음식이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A dish made by boiling scorched rice in water.

phrases.en: It smells like toasty scorched rice.
phrases.nuance_ko: 맛이나 냄새를 말할 때 '구수한'과 잘 어울려요.
phrases.nuance_en: Goes well with 구수한 when talking about taste or smell.

phrases.en: I bought scorched rice snacks as a treat.
phrases.nuance_ko: 누룽지로 만든 과자를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to snacks made from scorched rice.

explain_en: It is the rice that sticks and browns on the bottom of the rice pot. If you add water and boil it, you can eat it as '누룽지탕' or as '숭늉', and these days it's also sold as snacks or tea. Its taste is described as '구수하다' or '고소하다'.

en: to scoop up; to ladle; to spoon up

examples.en: Try spooning up some of the broth first.

examples.ko: 아이스크림은 작은 숟가락으로 떠먹는 게 좋아요.
examples.en: It's nice to eat ice cream with a small spoon.

examples.ko: 곰국은 국물부터 떠먹어야 맛을 알 수 있어요.
examples.en: You have to taste the broth first to know how the beef soup is.

examples.ko: 밥만 떠먹지 말고 반찬도 같이 드세요.
examples.en: Don't just spoon up rice; eat side dishes with it too.
You eat pudding with a spoon.

examples.ko: 혼자 떠먹기 힘들면 제가 떠 줄게요.
examples.en: If it's hard to scoop and eat it yourself, I'll scoop it for you.

explain: 숟가락이나 국자로 떠서 먹는 방법을 말해요. '퍼먹다'는 더 많이, 마구 퍼서 먹는 느낌이 있어서 달라요. 음식 이름 앞에 '떠먹는 요구르트'처럼 붙이기도 해요.

phrases.en: I eat soup by scooping it with a spoon.
phrases.nuance_ko: 해요체 기본형이라 평소 습관을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The polite present form for describing a habit.

phrases.en: I like spoonable yogurt.
phrases.nuance_ko: '떠먹는'으로 음식 이름 앞에 붙여 종류를 나타내요.
phrases.nuance_en: 떠먹는 before a food name shows the type that you eat with a spoon.

phrases.en: It's hot, so don't scoop it up and eat it right away.
phrases.nuance_ko: 부정 명령형이라 조심하라고 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A negative command used as a warning.

explain_en: It describes eating by scooping with a spoon or ladle. '퍼먹다' feels more like shoveling in a lot, so it is different. It can also come before a food name, as in '떠먹는 요구르트'.

examples.en: In summer, cool makguksu is the best.

examples.ko: 춘천에 가면 막국수를 꼭 먹어 봐요.
examples.en: If you go to Chuncheon, be sure to try makguksu.
Please add vinegar and mustard to your makguksu.
This place's makguksu comes in a big portion.
Not the spicy mixed one, please give me the cold broth makguksu.
Do you want to go eat makguksu for lunch today?

explain: 메밀로 만든 국수라서 '메밀국수'와 가까운 음식이에요. 하지만 막국수는 강원도 쪽 음식 이름으로 알려져 있어요. 식당에서는 국물이 있는 '물 막국수'와 양념에 비비는 '비빔 막국수'로 나눠 주문해요.

phrases.en: I ordered water makguksu.
phrases.nuance_ko: 국물이 있는 막국수를 말하는 식당 주문 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A restaurant term for makguksu served in broth.

phrases.en: I want to eat spicy mixed makguksu.
phrases.nuance_ko: 양념에 비빈 막국수를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to makguksu mixed with sauce.

phrases.en: One bowl of makguksu, please.
phrases.nuance_ko: 식당에서 주문할 때 가장 자주 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common phrase when ordering at a restaurant.

explain_en: It is a buckwheat noodle dish, so it is close to '메밀국수'. But makguksu is known as a food associated with the Gangwon region. At restaurants you order either '물 막국수' with broth or '비빔 막국수' mixed with sauce.

examples.ko: 엄마가 해 주신 장조림이 제일 맛있어요.
examples.en: The jangjorim my mom makes is the tastiest.
Jangjorim is just right as a side dish for rice.
I asked them to pack jangjorim in my lunchbox.

examples.ko: 장조림 국물에 밥을 비벼 먹으면 맛있어요.
examples.en: Rice mixed with jangjorim broth is delicious.
I tried making jangjorim with quail eggs.

examples.ko: 장조림을 만들 때는 간장을 넉넉히 넣어요.
examples.en: When making jangjorim, I add plenty of soy sauce.

explain: '-조림'은 '감자조림', '고등어조림'처럼 졸인 반찬에 붙는 말이에요. 장조림은 짭짤해서 밥에 얹어 먹거나 비벼 먹어요. 소고기 말고 메추리알이나 두부를 넣기도 해요.

phrases.en: I made beef jangjorim on the weekend.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가장 흔한 장조림이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: This is the most common kind of jangjorim.

phrases.en: I like quail egg jangjorim.
phrases.nuance_ko: 작은 메추리알을 간장에 졸인 반찬이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: It is a side dish of small quail eggs simmered in soy sauce.

phrases.en: I put jangjorim in the lunchbox.
phrases.nuance_ko: 도시락 반찬으로 자주 쓰는 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common way to talk about it as a lunchbox side dish.

explain_en: '-조림' is attached to braised side dishes, like '감자조림' and '고등어조림'. Jangjorim is salty, so people eat it over rice or mixed into it. Besides beef, quail eggs or tofu are sometimes added.

examples.ko: 사전에서 낱말을 찾으면 뜻풀이 아래에 용례가 함께 나와요.
examples.en: When you look up a word in the dictionary, examples appear below the definition.

examples.ko: 모르는 단어는 뜻풀이를 먼저 읽어 보세요.
examples.en: For words you don't know, read the definition first.
This dictionary is good because its definitions are easy.

examples.ko: 선생님이 어려운 말의 뜻풀이를 해 주셨어요.
examples.en: The teacher explained the meanings of the difficult words.
I can't get the feeling from the definition alone.
I wrote the definition on the back of the word card.

explain: '뜻'은 단어가 가진 의미 자체이고, '뜻풀이'는 그 의미를 설명해 놓은 글이에요. 그래서 '뜻풀이를 읽다', '뜻풀이를 하다'처럼 말해요. 한자어로는 '정의'라고 해요.

phrases.en: Read the definition in the dictionary slowly.
phrases.nuance_ko: 사전에서 단어를 찾을 때 가장 기본적인 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most basic collocation when looking up a word in a dictionary.

phrases.example: 모르는 말은 뜻풀이를 보면 알 수 있어요.
phrases.en: If you look at the definition, you can understand words you don't know.
phrases.nuance_ko: '읽다'보다 가볍게 눈으로 확인한다는 느낌이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Feels lighter than 읽다, more like glancing at it.

phrases.en: The dictionary definition is too difficult.
phrases.nuance_ko: '사전'을 앞에 붙여 어디에 있는 뜻풀이인지 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: 사전 in front shows where the definition comes from.

explain_en: Plain explanation of a word's meaning, as in dictionaries. '뜻' is the meaning a word has, while '뜻풀이' is the written explanation of that meaning, so you say '뜻풀이를 읽다' or '뜻풀이를 하다'. The Sino-Korean word for it is '정의'.

t90.ax: I can't get the feeling from the definition alone.

examples.en: Please write your Korean name in the Roman alphabet.
The name is written in Roman letters on the passport.

examples.ko: 로마자로 쓰면 한국어 발음을 알기 쉬워요.
examples.en: If you write it in Roman letters, the Korean pronunciation is easy to see.

examples.ko: 이 간판에는 한글과 로마자가 같이 있어요.
examples.en: This sign has both Hangul and Roman letters.
I'm learning the Romanization rules these days.
The spelling of the Roman-letter name is wrong.

explain: 영어뿐 아니라 프랑스어, 스페인어 같은 여러 언어가 쓰는 라틴 문자를 가리켜요. 한글을 로마자로 옮겨 적는 걸 '로마자 표기'라고 해요. 일상에서는 '알파벳'이라고도 해요.

phrases.example: 한글 이름의 로마자 표기를 알려 주세요.
phrases.en: Please tell me the Roman alphabet spelling of the Korean name.
phrases.nuance_ko: 한글을 로마자로 옮겨 적는 방법을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for how Korean is written in the Roman alphabet.

phrases.en: I changed Korean words into the Roman alphabet.
phrases.nuance_ko: '바꾸다'로 글자를 옮기는 동작을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: 바꾸다 describes the action of changing the script.

phrases.en: Please write your name in the alphabet.
phrases.nuance_ko: 일상에서는 로마자 대신 이렇게도 많이 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: In daily speech people often say this instead of 로마자.

explain_en: It refers to the Latin script used not only by English but by French, Spanish and many other languages. Writing Hangul in these letters is called '로마자 표기'. In daily talk people also say '알파벳'.
